newsitem.title: USA: Raven Industries expects record earnings.
newsitem.headline: Raven Industries expects record earnings.

text.p: Raven Industries Inc said Monday it expected to report record sales and earnings for the full year.

Raven, a maker of plastic and electronics products, said Monday it earned $1.6 million or $0.33 a share in the second quarter compared with $1.4 million or $0.30 during the same period a year earlier.
The company said it expected to have "solid results" for the second half and record sales and net earnings for its full year ending January 31.

At Raven's plastics unit, sales rose 17 percent during the quarter, bolstered by strong performance in the plastic and fiberglass tank business. A major portion of the gain came from the acquisition of Norcore Plastics in January. Norcore was expected to add about $8 million in sales this year.

At the electronics segment, sales were relatively flat, but operating income rose. Raven said it had expected both sales and operating profit to improve during the period, but the sales picked up late. July was a good month, but the increase began too late to boost sales for the quarter overall.
Raven's sewn products segment posted a five percent increase in sales during the quarter.
